issues.description: The solution implements Course.addRating(stars:) with a Bool return type (indicating success/failure), but the template's extension declares addRating(stars:) with no return type and the problem statement does not specify any return value. This creates a structural mismatch between template and solution and may confuse students about the intended method signature (and whether they should return a Bool).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the intended signature explicit and consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement and the template to require and declare addRating(stars:) -> Bool (and explain that the Bool indicates whether the rating was accepted), or (B) change the solution to match the template by removing the Bool return and implementing validation with no return. Prefer option A if you want the method to communicate success/failure.
